sentences.en: And Warren E. Buffett presciently observed five years ago that derivatives were "financial weapons of mass destruction, carrying dangers that, while now latent, are potentially lethal."
sentences.vi: Và Warren E. Buffett đã từng quan sát cách đây 5 năm rằng các công cụ phái sinh là ""vũ khí tài chính hủy diệt hàng loạt, mang theo những mối nguy hiểm mà hiện nay tiềm ẩn, có khả năng gây chết người.""

sentences.en: And he bravely and presciently took a huge writedown by selling a $30 billion portfolio of CDOs for 22 cents on the dollar.

sentences.en: But Reagan's speech presciently identified Berlin as the proving ground of Gorbachev's intentions to open up the communist bloc.

sentences.en: More presciently than they superiors, these workers grasped the economic situation.

sentences.en: Most presciently, China seems to have learned the major lesson of public diplomacy: product trumps packaging every time.

sentences.en: He pointed presciently to countries such as China and India that were building their modernisation plans around science.
